description: Bycatch from the fz-kdt.104 build (2026-08-31, measured at 50a33e49c): fixture 00421's error output differs run-to-run AT BASE -- the UnresolvedWait diagnostic renders a SET in iteration order, and the base binary alone produced three different output md5s across three runs. Pre-existing, unrelated to fz-kdt.104 (verified). Violates canonical-comparand discipline for user-facing diagnostics: error messages must render collections in a stable order (sort at the presentation boundary -- legal packaging sort). Find the render site, order it, and add 00421 (or a cheaper case) as a stable-output pin.
title: UnresolvedWait set iteration order leaks into an error message: base binary prints 3 different md5s on 3 runs of 00421
